3 pricing cards (emerging, professional, institutional) with data-testid

4 benefit cards with icons and staggered reveal

context_for_next_testing_agent: All scroll/reveal animations verified working across 6 public pages. Uses IntersectionObserver hook from /hooks/useAnimations.js.
